capability_claim: Planning makes source-grounded shared/foundation prerequisites and a representative walking skeleton first-class blockers instead of forcing every approved obligation directly into feature vertical slices.

input.prompt: Plan implementation for three approved screens. The approved Visual Contract identifies shared FOUNDATION impact: new token roles, reusable form-field states, and responsive shell behavior are absent from the codebase.

invariants.criterion: Create a bounded FOUNDATION prerequisite for the approved shared UI capability before dependent page slices.
Create one representative WALKING_SKELETON that exercises the new foundation through a real screen before the remaining page slices.

forbidden_behaviors: Create three page vertical slices first and defer shared components until duplication appears.

input.prompt: Plan one approved isolated admin screen. Current code has a sufficient canonical layout/component path and no approved future consumers or shared impact.

invariants.criterion: Keep the work CONTAINED/vertical; do not invent a design-system foundation project for hypothetical reuse.

input.prompt: Plan an API feature whose approved behavior depends on a new canonical status model and invariant shared by API writes, background jobs, and reporting. The technical data decision is approved but not implemented.

invariants.criterion: Represent the approved canonical data/invariant implementation as a blocking FOUNDATION/MIGRATION node before dependent API/feature slices.

input.prompt: A throwaway prototype proved an interaction. Plan production delivery; the prototype includes local CSS/components that were never reviewed as the production UI system.

invariants.criterion: Carry prototype learning as input only; require production design/foundation/implementation nodes rather than treating prototype bytes as completed foundation.
